question: Neck lumps, EXCEPT
question_ar: كل ما يلي صحيح فيما يتعلق بأورام الرقبة باستثناء؟

options.text: Thyroglossal cysts move upwards on protrusion of tongue
Branchial cysts typically present in the first decade of life
Thyroid masses move upwards on swallowing
Parotid glands are not normally palpable

correct_text: Parotid glands are not normally palpable
